# India Today

> > India Today is India's leading news and media platform delivering comprehensive coverage of national news, international affairs, politics, sports, education, and current events across India and the world.

India Today provides breaking news from major Indian cities including Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Chennai, along with in-depth coverage of political developments, exam results, cricket tournaments, environmental issues, and global affairs. The platform serves as a comprehensive resource for Indian and international news, featuring photojournalism, election coverage, and educational guidance.

## Key Topics

- India national news
- BJP and Indian politics
- Bengaluru and Chennai city news
- Crime incidents and local news
- Board exam results (RBSE, UP Board, Telangana SSC)
- Cricket World Cup and sports
- Pakistan and Iran international relations
- Delhi and Mumbai developments
- Tamil Nadu regional coverage
- Education and study abroad
- Environmental issues
- Photojournalism and current events
- Assembly elections
- Global news from England and New Zealand

## Core News Coverage

- [India News](https://www.indiatoday.in/india): Breaking India news on politics, crime, Karnataka & Bengaluru developments
- [Global News](https://www.indiatoday.in/global): International news covering crime, politics & events from France to Illinois
- [US News](https://www.indiatoday.in/world/us-news): US breaking news: FBI investigations, Michigan synagogue attack & crime
- [Environment](https://www.indiatoday.in/environment): Environment news on water crisis, air pollution in Delhi, Chennai, Bengaluru

## Elections and Politics

- [Assam Assembly Election 2026](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections/assembly/assam): Assam Assembly Election 2026: BJP, Congress & Himanta Sarma coverage
- [J&K Assembly Election Results](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections/assembly/jammu-and-kashmir/constituency-list): J&K Assembly Election 2024 constituency-wise winning candidates list

## City News

- [Bengaluru News](https://www.indiatoday.in/cities/bengaluru-news): Bengaluru local news on crime, LPG shortage & Karnataka city updates
- [Chennai News](https://www.indiatoday.in/cities/chennai-news): Chennai local news covering H5N1, DMK politics & Tamil Nadu updates
- [Coimbatore News](https://www.indiatoday.in/cities/coimbatore-news): Coimbatore local news covering Tamil Nadu crime & safety incidents

## Education and Exam Results

- [UP Board Class 10th Result 2025](https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today/up-board-class-10th-result): UPMSP UP Board Class 10th Result 2025 checking guide & updates
- [RBSE Rajasthan Board Varishtha Upadhyay Result 2025](https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today/rajasthan-board-varishtha-upadhyay-result): RBSE Varishtha Upadhyay Class 12 Result 2025 from Rajasthan Board
- [Telangana SSC 10th Result 2025](https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today/telangana-ts-ssc-10th-board-result): Telangana Board SSC Class 10 Result 2025 checking guide & scorecard
- [MBA Courses in Canada](https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today/study-abroad-courses/canada/mba-master-of-business-administration): MBA in Canada guide: Rotman, Smith schools, fees, eligibility for Indians

## Sports and Cricket

- [T20 World Cup India Squad 2026](https://www.indiatoday.in/live-score/cricket/teams/t20-world-cup-13203-india-4): T20 World Cup 2026 India squad with Suryakumar Yadav, defending champions

## Features and Special Coverage

- [Photo Feature](https://www.indiatoday.in/photo-feature): Photo journalism covering Dharavi, Mahakumbh, ICC World Cup & Sachin Tendulkar
- [Anniversary Special](https://www.indiatoday.in/anniversary): India Today 49th anniversary special on national milestones & achievements
- [High and Mighty](https://www.indiatoday.in/high-and-mighty): Power list 2024 rankings: Dhruv Rathee, Sadhguru & India's top influencers

## Optional

- [Authors and Young Achievers](https://www.indiatoday.in/authors): Young achievers in politics, business, cinema featuring Alia & Mahesh Bhatt
